android.desc:
Turn your Android phone into a powerful wireless Bluetooth keyboard for your Windows PC — no apps to install on your computer, no Wi-Fi needed, no cables required. TapToType uses Bluetooth HID technology to connect your phone directly to your PC as a real keyboard.

⌨️ TWO TYPING MODES FOR EVERY SITUATION

• Live Mode — Each keystroke is sent to your PC in real-time, just like a physical keyboard. Perfect for remote control, presentations, quick searches, and typing from the couch.

• Compose Mode — Write and edit your full message on your phone first, then send it all at once with a single tap. Ideal for long messages, emails, and chat replies.

🔗 ONE-TAP BLUETOOTH CONNECTION

TapToType pairs with your Windows PC via standard Bluetooth — no companion app or special software needed on your computer. Your phone appears as a native Bluetooth keyboard, just like any wireless keyboard you'd buy in a store.

• Save multiple PCs for instant one-tap reconnection
• Stays connected in the background — switch apps without losing your keyboard session
• Guided setup wizard walks you through pairing step by step

💡 KEY FEATURES

✅ Real Bluetooth HID keyboard — works with any Windows PC
✅ No software required on PC — zero installation
✅ No Wi-Fi or internet needed — direct Bluetooth connection
✅ Live keystroke mode for real-time typing
✅ Compose & send mode for drafting messages
✅ Background connection — keeps working when you switch apps
✅ Save & name your devices for quick reconnection
✅ Enter key behavior: choose Enter (submit) or Shift+Enter (line break)
✅ Light & dark theme support
✅ Built-in diagnostics & connection logs
✅ Step-by-step connection wizard
✅ Material Design UI — clean, modern, and premium

🖥️ PERFECT FOR

• Typing on your PC from your couch or bed
• Controlling presentations from across the room
• Typing passwords or search queries quickly
• Using your phone keyboard instead of a tiny laptop keyboard
• Gamers who need a mobile chat keyboard
• Remote desktop and media PC control

🔒 PRIVACY FIRST

TapToType does not collect, store, or transmit any of your keystrokes or personal data. All typing data goes directly from your phone to your PC over Bluetooth — nothing is sent to the internet. No account required.

📋 REQUIREMENTS

• Android 9.0 (Pie) or higher
• Bluetooth-enabled Android phone
• Windows PC with Bluetooth

Download TapToType now and start typing on your PC from your phone — it's that simple.

quotes.text:
ugh i totally get this. trying to wrangle a coding agent on a phone with a virtual keyboard is just... awful. i've been using this app called Tap To Type on my android, it makes my phone a proper bluetooth keyboard for my laptop. no extra software on the computer needed, just pairs up like any wireless keyboard, and it has a mode where you can type out a whole message before sending it all at once, which is great for longer inputs.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.taptotype
